BiblicalUsage: Gilalai is a person named once in Scripture, in Nehemiah. The full story lives on the Gilalai profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gilalai matters because God keeps names in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
